name: widget-grid
title: Widget Grid
description: Draggable and resizable widget layout on a CSS grid with keyboard edit affordances.

api.description: Draggable and resizable widget layout on a CSS grid with keyboard edit affordances.

props.name: onLayoutChange
props.description: Called after a move or resize commits.

props.name: renderWidget
props.description: Render function for each layout id (required).

props.name: editable
props.description: When false, drag, resize, and keyboard edit affordances are disabled.

props.name: minRowHeight
props.description: CSS length override for --df-widget-grid-row-height on this instance.

props.name: emptyContent
props.description: Content when the layout array is empty.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name for the grid. Defaults to the kit string catalogue. Override when the host supplies a visible heading.

groups.title: Accessibility
groups.description: Grid name: Pass aria-label when a visible title is not enough; otherwise the catalogue default names the grid. Widget content: renderWidget must supply meaningful content and names inside each cell. Drag handles: Editable cells expose move and resize controls with catalogue labels. Live region: Keyboard edits announce the new cell position and size.
